articles.title: S&P Global Mobility Announces Appointment of Renato Negro as Chief Accounting Officer for Standalone Company
articles.mainIdea: S&P Global Mobility Announces Appointment of Renato Negro as Chief Accounting Officer for Standalone Company
articles.summary: PR Newswire: S&P Global Mobility Announces Appointment of Renato Negro as Chief Accounting Officer for Standalone Company. S&P Global Mobility ("Mobility Global") today announced the appointment of Renato Negro as Chief Accounting Officer effective April 6, 2026. Mr. Negro will lead organization-wide accounting, tax, financial reporting, and compliance for Mobility Global following its planned separation into a standalone public company. He will report to Matt Calderone, who will serve as Chief Financial Officer of Mobility Global. Related tickers mentioned: ESAB.

articles.title: Weekly Stock List
articles.summary: Argus Research: Weekly Stock List. Argus is hosting a five-part webinar series on AI, examining the ways that different sectors are incorporating AI practices. We recently completed our third webinar, featuring the Financial sector. AI is helping Financial companies become leaner, more efficient, and more service/customer focused. Financial sector companies tend to be big spenders on technology and have been early leaders in adopting AI practices. There are many ways these companies use AI strategies, including in back-office processes, fraud detection, compliance, improved customer service, marketing, or for completing mundane or repetitive tasks (like reading or analyzing data). Banks, brokerages, payment processors, insurance companies are some of the industries within the overall sector. For our list this week, we've put together a cheat sheet from our recent webinar, highlighting some of our BUY-rated Financial sector companies that are taking the lead in the use of AI. Related tickers mentioned: BK, BK-PK, CB, ICE, JPM, MS, MS-PQ, TRV, V, XYZ.
